title: Import mapping
description: How an inventory's columns, values and codes become the model's, for terrane import csv --map.

file.description: The inventory file, in the --from folder: a .csv, or an .xlsx workbook. Default: <type>.csv.

sheet.description: The sheet of a workbook the rows are on. Default: the first sheet with a header row.

code.description: The column holding the inventory's own id. Kept in cmdb_ci_sys_id where the type has it, and matched when another row names this one.

from.description: Slug the name or the code. Default: name.

columns.description: Inventory column: the field, or the fields, it fills.

ignore.description: Columns read by nothing, on purpose; any other column not mapped is reported as left out.

values.description: Per field, inventory value: the model's value.

defaults.description: Per field, the value when the inventory's is empty or there is no column.
